name: Maple Leaf Placemat
finished_size: About 38 cm wide by 35 cm long

yarn.description: Cotton yarn for the leaf placemat

gauge: 24 sts and 20 rows = 10 cm in hdc worked in BLO, after light blocking.

steps.label: Row 1
steps.text: Ch 6. Sc in the 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn.

steps.label: Rows 2-12
steps.text: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn. The turning ch does not count as a st.

steps.label: Row 13
steps.text: Ch 1, work 3 sc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 14
steps.text: Ch 1, [sc, inc] rep 5 times, sc in the last 5 sts; turn.

steps.label: Row 15
steps.text: Ch 1, [sc, inc] rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 16
steps.text: Ch 1, [2 sc, inc] rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 17
steps.text: Ch 1, [3 sc, inc] rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 18
steps.text: Ch 1, [4 sc, inc] rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 19
steps.text: Ch 1, [5 sc, inc] rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 20
steps.text: Ch 1, [6 sc, inc] rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 21
steps.text: Ch 1, [7 sc, inc] rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Rows 22-58
steps.text: Ch 1, hdc in BLO of each st across; turn. The turning ch does not count as a st.

steps.label: Row 59
steps.text: Ch 1, [7 sc, dec] rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 60
steps.text: Ch 1, [6 sc, dec] rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 61
steps.text: Ch 1, [5 sc, dec] rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 62
steps.text: Ch 1, [4 sc, dec] rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 63
steps.text: Ch 1, [3 sc, dec] rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 64
steps.text: Ch 1, [2 sc, dec] rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 65
steps.text: Ch 1, [sc, dec] rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 66
steps.text: Ch 1, dec rep 10 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 67
steps.text: Ch 1, dec rep 5 times; turn.

steps.label: Row 68
steps.text: Ch 1, dec twice, sc in the last st; turn.

steps.label: Row 69
steps.text: Ch 1, dec, sc in the last st; turn.

steps.label: Row 70
steps.text: Ch 1, dec. Do not turn.

steps.label: Edging
steps.text: Ch 1 and turn. Treat the top st, 69 row ends down one side, 5 unused foundation chs, and 69 row ends up the other side as 144 edge positions. In the top st, work (sc, hdc, dc, tr, ch 2, tr, dc, hdc, sc). *Sc in each of the next 7 edge positions, then work (sc, hdc, dc, tr, ch 2, tr, dc, hdc, sc) in the next edge position; rep 17 times. Sc in each of the last 7 edge positions, then sl st to the first sc.

finishing: Fasten off after joining the edging, leaving a 15 cm tail.
Weave in both yarn tails on the reverse side without pulling the leaf out of shape.
Wet-block the placemat to its approximate finished size. Pin the pointed edging evenly and allow it to dry completely.
notes: Each pointed edging cluster is worked into one edge position; the ch 2 forms the tip of the lobe.
Place a stitch marker in the first sc of the edging cluster if it helps identify the final joining point.
